description: This Java class, LogWrapper, acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface. It facilitates logging by forwarding log data to the Android Log system and optionally passing it along to a chained LogNode, enabling flexible log handling.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android’s native Log utility to integrate with a custom logging chain, implementing the LogNode interface.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message using Android's Log class and passes it along the chain if applicable.
